versions.changelog:
- Initial release of shared legal building blocks for Box-based workflows.
- Provides Box collaboration role definitions and guidance on least privilege and access confirmation.
- Clearly defines Box AI usage boundaries—AI supports, but does not make, key legal decisions.
- Includes reusable, human-in-the-loop confirmation prompts for risk ratings, permissions, routing, completeness, and more.
- Designed for use by other legal workflow skills (M&A, Intake, Contract Review).
